label: VERIFIED
extraction: Multi-agent repo key concepts across frameworks. Memory and context management: persistent state allows agents to reference previous steps or summarize long conversations. Workflow orchestration: flows, DAGs, or event-driven architectures manage order of actions, error handling, and retries. AG2 (AutoGen 2): async conversation between specialized agents; event-driven architecture allows concurrent work, reduces bottlenecks, supports human-in-the-loop. CrewAI: role-based orchestration with agents assigned roles (Researcher, Writer, Critic). LangGraph: represents agent reasoning as DAG for deterministic flows. OpenAI Agents SDK: lightweight runtime with function-calling and agent handoffs, guardrails for safety. Google ADK: agent development kit. Framework comparison table covers key characteristics and why each is interesting.
